subject: [hw] DONE V17 (VFP scalar, A32+T32)
body:
DONE V17. Host-tested only; no phone, no publish. Commits 13c149f + 6f00cfb.

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v17/run_tests.sh (both the ASan+UBSan -O1 and the plain -O2 build, ~7 s, /tmp/n2hw-V17 only):
    N2TEST V17 PASS 2199/2199
It also prints: V17 sweep: 200000 random VFP words: 58209 executed, 141791 UNDEF (all UNDEF are unallocated encodings in the forced VFP groups; no crash, PC untouched).

Implemented in my owned files only:
  emu/n2a32_vfp.c (1597 lines), emu/n2a32_fp_util.h (shared rounding + integer-code saturating float->int helpers for V18-V20)
  emu/test_v17/{run_tests.sh,gen_enc.py,vectors.s,vectors_t32.s,t_vfp.c,k_v17_fp.c,vfp_demo.s,vfp_demo_t32.s,STATUS.md}
308 llvm-mc encodings (A32 + Thumb-2), 2199 checks: all load/store (incl. FLDMX odd-imm8), VMOV core<->S/D including two-core and all lane size/sign forms, VDUP from core, VMRS/VMSR FPSCR, all 13 arithmetic ops (fused VFMA family tested by cancellation), VABS/VNEG/VSQRT, VCMP/VCMPE, VCVT single<->double/int/fixed/half, VSEL/VMAXNM/VMINNM/VRINTx/VCVT{A,N,P,M}, FPSCR DN/FZ/RMode/exception bits, r15/SP operands, Thumb-2 twins, and the 200000-word sweep.

R1 findings: F12 (VMOV core<->single) was already fixed in the tree R1 re-checked; F11 (VSEL must use FPSCR.NZCV, not APSR) is fixed in 6f00cfb and covered by cases with APSR deliberately opposite to FPSCR. Please re-check.

Core integration: asmrun A32 and Thumb-2 vfp_demo.s both produce the exact expected 36 bytes (VSQRT+VADD, VSELEQ, VRINTA, VMAXNM, VCVT fixed, VDUP, VMOV lane). T01 run_diff with this class in emu/: arm-O0 2340/2340 calls, 0 mismatch, 0 stop; remaining failures are other classes.

Census: all 37 scalar VFP mnemonics in D01s VFP list (FACTS.md 4.9) are implemented; vrshr/vsra/vrsra/vdup in that line are NEON (V19/V20). No V17 UNDEF intersects the vendor set.

Not done / unresolved (also in test_v17/STATUS.md): not compiled for arm64 iOS (no SDK sysroot), not run on the phone, no perf; FLDMX extra word modelled as FPSCR (VFPv2 mixed format not modelled); VCVT fixed fbits field decode derived from llvm-mc+ARM ARM; FP->int saturation/IOC and some IXC-on-invalid choices documented; FZ exact-subnormal UFC and host after-rounding tininess are approximations; VMOV #0.0 immediate cannot be assembled by llvm-mc 23.1.4 so it is only covered by the sweep.
I stay available for review findings.
